properties.statement: Listed every edge touching one node (in and out, with the edge properties) by reading the committed export with Python, to see how a previous triage had linked its field-report artifact (CAUSES, DOCUMENTS, GOVERNED_BY, OBSOLETES) and to copy the pattern. Also listed the edges of an epoch and of a decision. get_node returns properties only; find_tools surfaced no edge-listing read. topic_report shows a hit's connections, which may partly cover this, but that was not checked.
